report.summary: Identified three cross-file patterns: (1) mutual reliance on unverifiable past measurements with no committed commands, (2) unguarded fallbacks when external modules return empty/None, (3) inconsistent handle-sharing assumptions across containment boundaries.
risks: Measurement provenance gap: multiple modules (graph_delta, render, containment) reference past measurements or behaviors that cannot be reproduced, undermining auditability.
Silent degradation: several functions assume external modules always return non-empty data; an empty return can cause crashes or incorrect behavior without logging.
Containment boundary fragility: LowIntegrityLog relies on hardcoded constants and external functions not defined in the scanned chunk; any mismatch breaks the security guarantee.
todos: Verify that all external functions referenced by graph_delta, render, and containment are defined and have the expected signatures.
Add guards for empty returns from external modules (e.g., mutate.generate, parse.sections) and log warnings.
Ensure all committed commands for measurements are recorded; consider adding a command registry check.

hypotheses.claim: Multiple modules rely on historical measurements or behaviors that were produced by throwaway scripts with no committed commands, making them unreproducible and thus non-actionable.
hypotheses.mechanism: graph_delta.py docstrings reference a 75.3% held-out figure and 0.9%/0.7% false-alarm figures from a throwaway script. render.py references drift.check behavior not in chunk. containment.py references NtCreateFile measurements not in chunk. None of these measurements have committed commands to reproduce them.
hypotheses.refuted_by: If all referenced measurements have associated committed commands in the repository that can be re-run to reproduce the same numbers, this hypothesis is refuted.

hypotheses.claim: Several functions assume external modules return non-empty or valid data without guarding against empty/None returns, leading to silent failures or crashes.
hypotheses.mechanism: graph_delta.held_out uses generate.last_filtered and generate.last_rejected which may be empty or missing. markdown._render accesses parse.sections[0].source without checking if sections is empty. render.main calls drift_mod.refresh and inventory_mod.refresh with reports; if reports is empty, behavior is undefined.
hypotheses.refuted_by: If all such external modules guarantee non-empty returns (e.g., always return at least one section, or attributes are always present) and this is documented, the hypothesis is refuted.

hypotheses.claim: Containment boundary assumes only one handle crosses the boundary, but other modules may inadvertently share handles or bypass the LowIntegrityLog class.
hypotheses.mechanism: containment.py claims only LowIntegrityLog's handle crosses the boundary and spawn_contained only accepts that type. However, render.py imports modules that may create their own file handles (e.g., drift_mod, inventory_mod) that are not governed by containment. If those modules open files with lower integrity, the containment guarantee is broken.
hypotheses.refuted_by: If all file operations in the codebase that interact with contained processes go through LowIntegrityLog and spawn_contained enforces the type, this hypothesis is refuted.
